subject: general
question: In which state of India is Konark dance festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __Odisha____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Konark Dance Festival is a five-day dance festival held every year in the month of December in the backdrop of the Sun Temple in Konark, Odisha, India.
 
• It is organized from 1 to 5 December every year since 1986.
 
• The festival will showcase dance forms like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Manipuri, Kuchipudi and many more.
 
• The International Sand Art Festival began in 2015 at Chandrabhaga Beach, Konark, Puri, Odisha, India.
 
• As many as 30 Indian and 10 foreign artists participate in this Competition-turned-Festival.
 
• The **Sun Temple at Konark **was given the status of a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1984.
 
• Jagannath Ratha Yatra is the famous festival of Odisha.
